run_report_metrics_cli: run the CLI to compute and print evaluation metrics for multiple models from eval directories
process_files_metrics: process a list of metric files and return a merged dictionary of extracted metrics keyed by configuration
get_dataframe_for_model: generate a pandas DataFrame summarizing sequence repetition, perplexity, and accuracy metrics per model
print_metrics_dict: format a metrics dictionary as a CSV-compatible key-value string pair
get_metric_completions: extract ngram-based metrics and unique token counts from completion output files
